cand.title: GVA Workshop 2027
cand.organizationName: Travel Inside / Primus Publishing (event organizer not fully established)
cand.excerpt: High evidence and geographic fit outrank generic Geneva demand; incumbent venue/accessibility is penalized where applicable.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Nicolas Simonin, Genève Aéroport, Responsable développement Tourisme/Transport: documented event organizer and official exhibitor-registration contact, nicolas.simonin@gva.ch. Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Genève Aéroport, Chef de service Business development: documented event co-organizer and senior business-development relationship contact. Both are commercially relevant access points; neither is proven to control hotel contracts or a 2027 accommodation budget.
findings.futureEdition: 27 May 2027, single-day fifth edition, at restaurant Le Chef, Geneva Airport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. The activity date is explicitly reported by event media partner TRAVEL INSIDE on 12 October 2026; it is not the article date. Within the requested horizon. The airport itself announced a fifth edition in 2027, but its retrieved event webpage still describes 4 June 2026: exact 2027 date and venue have media-partner provenance, not an independently located 2027 organizer prospectus. No 2028 edition announcement located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using supplied hotel specifications: airport-corridor geography is relevant, and historical attendance is below YOTEL’s stated approximately 250-theatre maximum, but plenary capacity does not establish fit for the airline-table rotation layout. This is a local/regional afternoon-evening trade workshop, not relocation or extended-stay demand and not a resort retreat. Founex requires an off-airport transfer. Only independently confirmed non-local organizer/exhibitor stays or separate airport-partner meetings would support a lodging proposal. No evidenced room demand justifies a 20–120-room block or whole-house assumption.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 venue is publicly announced as restaurant Le Chef, Route de l’aéroport 13, third floor, CH-1215 Geneva. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, downtown Geneva or Lausanne. Le Chef is a restaurant, not a competing hotel. This is a published venue selection, not evidence of an executed venue contract or room allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: 2023 first edition: 22 June, Le Chef; about 60 travel agents and about 20 airlines. 2024 second edition: 6 June, Le Chef; more than 100 people including visitors, exhibitors and organizers, with 27 airlines on 22 stands. 2025 third edition: 22 May, Le Chef; about 130 participants. 2026 fourth edition: 4 June, Le Chef; airport reports more than 130 professionals overall, while TRAVEL INSIDE reports 90 travel agents/Travel Managers, a narrower category. No destination rotation evidenced across these editions. Earlier 28 May 2026 announcement was superseded by the organizer’s 4 June date; do not carry it forward.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, hotel room block, hotel list, lodging RFP, room-night total or peak-room figure identified in the reviewed announcement, official programme, exhibitor dossier or registration introduction. Therefore there are no published block hotels to name. Source scope: the official programme says “19h15 - 21h00 Cocktail dînatoire & Networking”; the exhibitor dossier specifies “1 table, 2 chaises” and “1 ticket de parking au maximum.” These describe meeting participation, not lodging. Silence does not establish either open sourcing or hotel commitment elsewhere.
findings.organizationStructure: Genève Aéroport owns/organizes this airport-led B2B trade workshop through its marketing/business-development team. It describes itself as an autonomous public establishment owned by the State of Geneva, not an association, PCO or DMC. TRAVEL INSIDE is explicitly the media partner; Primus Publishing appears in its publication footer, not as the established event buyer. Le Chef is the selected venue. Eventwise supplies the linked registration website; this alone does not establish a PCO or housing mandate.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Chef’s repeated use in 2023–2026 and announced selection for 2027 is the principal incumbent constraint; no competing lodging hotel is established. Historical 2024 provision of complimentary return CFF tickets for agents from Lausanne and beyond supports same-day access, not hotel stays. No sourced sell-out, capacity shortage, overflow or displaced room demand. The airport-centred format makes a venue switch to Founex less natural; this is a commercial inference, not an organizer rejection.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nicolas Simonin at the published work email, referencing 27 May 2027, and request a short qualification call with him and Yves-Daniel Viredaz. Confirm the 2027 date/venue directly; ask whether any non-local staff, speakers or airline representatives require overnight stays, who books/pays, existing hotel arrangements, actual rooms/dates, transfer needs and whether hotel partnership is permitted. Offer a site visit or conditional lodging/transfer proposal only after needs are established. Keep as low-priority relationship development rather than qualified group-room pipeline; final qualification remains with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the forthcoming 2027 edition, core event venue is already announced elsewhere. No open venue tender, housing tender or hotel allocation is evidenced. Historical 2026 participation routes were an airline-only exhibitor package and visitor registration for travel agents/Travel Managers; neither establishes YOTEL eligibility for a 2027 hotel exhibitor table or guaranteed access to the programme. Ancillary lodging remains unconfirmed, not closed or open by default.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship value is stronger than verified event room revenue. Approach the airport team for permission to introduce YOTEL to relevant travel managers and airline partners, and explore small separate meetings or genuinely required overnight stays. Do not pitch displacement of the committed 2027 workshop. Longer-term venue capture is speculative given the fixed-airport history; no 2028 date, relocation plan or RFP is published in the evidence reviewed.
